channel: l1-zkevm-protocol/_threads/Default to execution engine and proof engine
searchText: Yeah would suggest we write an issue detailing the design space and then making a decision to make progress. <@402080271563751435> was you leaning towards having the EL always be there or making it highly recommended? Upon reflection I think it's best to keep the EL as required as it is the more conservative approach and better fit for a proposal. This also means less diff and clean isolation in the specs. I would then defer to ACD if they want to change it to optional. I think we need to build up evidence of stable devnets with real proofs before we change this. But client teams can easily support no EL mode if they wish. We are supporting no EL in `eth-act/lighthouse`. I'm in agreement with this sounds good -- could we make an issue for this on consensus-specs? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5140
